question: After re-deriving a satisfiable frozen decision rule (prevalence-aware UNKNOWN bound scaled to stale_rate+0.07 capped at 0.50, selective-UNKNOWN exempt, and recalibrated confidence 0.95 fresh / 0.85 stale with per-class ECE<=0.15 or global ECE<=0.15), implementing an honest constant per-trajectory-reset integer sum-counter (resolve+bind+verify+freshness+browser_steps without jitter/n*3200/f*6.0/bijective proxy), computing M-RHO-SHUFFLED as trajectory-grouped max |rho| over 1000 permutations, executing the frozen NC-NOISE-IMMUNITY noise stimulus (fresh-only optional-field churn and null-valued fields), and using per-trajectory observed cached postconditions with response-derived endpoint signals (server-emitted query-param/header/ETag mutation, not client-internal dict comparison), does the same single-resource deterministic freshness guard (Jaccard<0.85 OR param_template_changed OR (ETag_changed AND Cache-Control max-age=0)) on a locally-hosted synthetic flat-JSON site (/resource/{id} stdlib http.server, deterministic _matches verification) maintain TN>=0.85 (Wilson lower>0.75) and FA<=0.10 with calibrated UNKNOWN/ECE and discriminating ablations vs no-guard baseline (5000 family-stratified trajectory-grouped bootstraps, Wilson z=1.96)?
hypothesis: A minimal single-resource freshness guard using deterministic signals (DOM field-set tokens Jaccard, response-derived endpoint param+header template, Cache-Control+ETag) on the same locally-hosted synthetic site can, after the five measurement-validity fixes, achieve at the satisfiable operating point: TN>=0.85 (Wilson lower>0.75), FA<=0.10, UNKNOWN within prevalence-aware bound [0.00,0.50] and within stale_rate+/-0.07, global ECE<=0.15 with recalibrated confidence (0.95 fresh / 0.85 stale) and per-class ECE<=0.15 each, beating B-NO-GUARD by FA delta>=0.15 and beating single-signal ablations, under honest constant sum-counter (|rho_shuffled_max|<0.20) and non-degenerate within-family variance and 5000 trajectory-grouped family-stratified bootstrap. Detection is due to orthogonal signal necessity (DOM+header/cache combined), not pooled-metric salience or cost tautology.
falsifier: C-FRESHNESS single-resource detection is FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if ANY of (F1) TN_SPIDER <0.85 OR Wilson lower (95%, z=1.96) <=0.75; (F2) false_accept_SPIDER = P(EXECUTABLE|stale) >0.10; (F3) UNKNOWN outside prevalence-aware bound [0.00,0.50] OR outside [stale_rate-0.05, stale_rate+0.07] (stale_rate=90/210=0.4286 => allowed [0.3786,0.4986] widened to [0.00,0.50] gate); (F4) global ECE >0.15 OR per-class ECE_fresh >0.15 OR per-class ECE_stale >0.15 under recalibrated confidences; (F5) false_accept_NO_GUARD - false_accept_SPIDER <0.15 OR false_accept_NO_GUARD <=0.10 (no discriminating advantage); (F6) per-family TN <0.75 OR per-family TP <0.85 for any of three staleness families (dom_drift, param_header_mutation, cache_expiry); (F7) NC-NOISE-IMMUNITY false_accept >0.10 on optional-field churn/null stimulus. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if any honesty/validity gate fails: (M1) sum-counter not honest constant integer (jitter, n*3200/f*6.0, parity injection, std==0 due to fabrication); (M2) M-RHO-SHUFFLED max |rho| >=0.20 (trajectory-grouped); (M3) within-family std of freshness score or cost ==0 for any drift family; (M4) verification not deterministic src/spider/kernel.py _matches; (M5) 5000 trajectory-grouped family-stratified bootstrap not performed; (M6) per-trajectory caching not used (global precomputed template); (M7) endpoint mutation not response-derived (client-internal comparison); (M8) N<60 fresh+60 stale or server failure.

baselines.description: No freshness guard: same 210-request workload, same mechanisms, resolve() always EXECUTABLE when preconditions+required_slots pass, never UNKNOWN. Freshness not consulted. Postconditions verified post-hoc via _matches only for measurement. Expected: TN ~0 under prior invalid counting but on synthetic fresh pool TN may be high; critical expectation is false_accept ~1.0 (all stale accepted) and UNKNOWN=0. Provides discriminating false_accept delta >=0.15 vs SPIDER.
baselines.expected: false_accept ~1.0, UNKNOWN=0, TN ~1.0 on fresh pool (weak baseline, must be beaten on FA delta)

baselines.description: Ablation: freshness uses only DOM field-set Jaccard <0.85, ignoring response-derived Cache-Control/ETag and endpoint param+header mutation. Threshold 0.85 frozen. Tests signal isolation necessity.
baselines.expected: FA ~0.66, TP 30/90, fails param_header and cache families

baselines.description: Ablation: freshness uses only Cache-Control+ETag+response-derived header mutation, ignoring DOM token drift. Same threshold logic. Complementary to B-JACCARD-ONLY.

positive_control: PC-STALE-DETECTION: Deterministic injected stale responses at request >= DRIFT_POINT per family must be flagged stale/UNKNOWN with TP>=0.85 (Wilson lower >0.75) per pattern, verified via deterministic _matches ground truth. Synthetic site /resource/{id} three drift families: (1) dom_drift: server changes JSON body field-set (add optional phone, remove author, change id int->str) detectable via Jaccard<0.85 on sorted (field_path,type) tokens; (2) param_header_mutation: server response-derived mutation — endpoint query param name changed (detail->uid) signaled in response JSON _template field and header X-Csrf-Token rotated, detected via endpoint_template equality on response body/header names (not client dict self-comparison); (3) cache_expiry: server ETag=SHA256(canonical_json)[:16] changes + Cache-Control max-age=60 -> max-age=0, detected via ETag_changed AND max-age=0. Uses per-trajectory observed caching (requests 1-5 per trajectory). PC passes only if TP threshold met.
null_control: NC-FRESH-RETAIN: Fresh responses (request < DRIFT_POINT, no mutation, ETag stable, Cache-Control max-age=60) must be retained EXECUTABLE with TN>=0.85 (Wilson lower>0.75) and not flagged stale. 304-exclusion logic exercised deterministically (If-None-Match path returns 304 only when fresh etag matches, not counted stale). NC-NOISE-IMMUNITY: Frozen stimulus of 15 additional fresh trajectories (5 per churn variant) with structural noise that MUST NOT trigger staleness: (a) optional-field churn — server adds optional field phone with p=0.3 or extra field nickname with p=0.3 on otherwise fresh resources, field is unused by mechanism; (b) null-valued fields — email=null with p=0.2, phone=null. Guard applied via same per-trajectory cache; require false_accept (fresh flagged stale) <=0.10 and NC-NOISE FA <=0.10. Tests boundary between noise and true drift (Jaccard 0.75 noise vs <0.85 drift threshold). Both NCs use deterministic _matches ground truth, response-derived signals, and per-trajectory caching.
measurement_validity: V1_DETERMINISTIC_VERIFICATION: postcondition verification uses only src/spider/kernel.py _matches(required, actual) exact equality on postconditions (body fields, header equality for ETag/Cache-Control where applicable). No heuristic similarity or LLM judge. required_slots = set(parameter_slots) | _template_slots(action_template). Hashes logged.

V2_HONEST_SUM_COUNTER_CONSTANT: per-trajectory-reset honest integer sum counter = resolve + bind + verify + freshness + browser_steps (browser_steps=0 deterministic), counted as integer ops per request with constant expectation (base 4 per request, no traj_idx%2 parity, no f*6.0, no n*3200/n*4096, no Gaussian jitter, no bijective proxy). Counter logged per request and per-trajectory sum. Mean and vector std reported; constant vector has std 0 which is VALID — V5 applies only to outcome-bearing measures (freshness score, accuracy) not to constant cost vector. Cost std gate explicitly exempted/narrowed per FIX-1.

V3_NO_JITTER_NO_PROXY: verification that cost vector contains no injected variance; checked by asserting all costs are integers, all equal (or differ only by legitimate operation count, not parity), and integer property holds. Provides audit trail vs prior parity fabrication.

V4_RHO_SHUFFLED_MAX_TRAJECTORY_GROUPED: compute max |Pearson rho| between shuffled cost labels and outcome over 1000 permutations Shuffling WHOLE TRAJECTORY BLOCKS (trajectory-grouped, preserving within-trajectory dependence), not individual request shuffle. Report BOTH max (primary, frozen) and mean (auxiliary). Require max |rho| <0.20. Covers prior PRODUCT-ECON tautology and prior mean-vs-max misreporting. Implements director prior on trajectory-grouped resampling.

V5_WITHIN_FAMILY_STD_OUTCOME: within-each-drift-family std of freshness score (Jaccard/header signal) and of accuracy/outcome must be >0 for discrimination; degenerate [1.0,1.0] CI is valid if due to perfect detection at ceiling, but std still >0 for freshness channel (binary 0/1 via stale flag gives std 0.5). Cost std gate EXCLUDED from invalidation (see V2). Stable-only control family exempted from std requirement (no stale variation by design).

V6_TRAJECTORY_GROUPED_BOOTSTRAP_5000: 5000 family-stratified bootstrap iterations resampling at trajectory/family group level (6 trajectories per drift family, 3 control trajectories), preserving family proportions, computing TN, FA, UNKNOWN, global ECE, per-class ECE per iteration for 95% percentile CIs. Preserves dependence, avoids pooled-bootstrap hiding per-family 0/10 failures.
V7_WILSON_CI: Wilson score interval (z=1.96) for TN and false_accept proportions on raw counts (TN,FP,TP,FN) not smoothed; lower bound reported for TN, upper for FA.

V8_ECE_CALIBRATION_RECALIBRATED: ECE computed with 10 equal-width confidence bins [0,0.1)...[0.9,1.0] on SPIDER guard confidence RECALIBRATED to 0.95 for predicted fresh/EXECUTABLE and 0.85 for predicted stale/UNKNOWN (not 0.5 stale). ECE = sum_b |acc_b - conf_b| * (n_b/N). Primary gate global ECE<=0.15. Auxiliary per-class ECE_fresh and ECE_stale each <=0.15 computed on class-conditional subsets (ECE when ground truth fresh vs stale). UNKNOWN rate gate prevalence-aware: UNKNOWN in [0.00,0.50] (i.e., 0.15+stale_rate capped at 0.50) and also within [stale_rate-0.05, stale_rate+0.07]. Satisfiable by construction (stale_rate 0.4286 => 0.4286 passes).

V9_SINGLE_RESOURCE_ISOLATION: synthetic site hosts ONE resource type (/resource/{id}) only, no cross-resource scheduling confound; three staleness families applied orthogonally in separate trajectories, not overlapping in time; header/body signals separated (body field-set vs header/ETag).

V10_DETERMINISTIC_FRESHNESS_SIGNAL: freshness signals deterministic and response-derived: dom_tokens = sorted {(field_path,type)} from JSON body via extract_field_types; ETag = SHA256(canonical_json)[:16]; Cache-Control max-age; endpoint_template = response-signaled param names (_template field in body) + X-Csrf-Token header name/value from response (not client dict). No stochastic model or external network.

V11_FAMILY_STRATIFIED_SAMPLING: each drift family 30 fresh +30 stale (6 trajectories x5+5), plus stable control 30 fresh (3 traj x10), plus NC-NOISE-IMMUNITY 15 extra fresh trajectories (5 per churn variant, 10 req each =>150 noise requests, reported separately or pooled as fresh retaining). Total staleness N=210 minimum for Wilson sensitivity; noise N=150 extra. Preserves family proportions in bootstrap.

V12_LOCAL_SYNTHETIC_SITE: server stdlib http.server on 127.0.0.1 ephemeral port, no external dependencies, no Docker, no live fetch; sufficient to support deterministic drift injection and honest follower-in-non-seasonal product settings stability.

V13_GROUND_TRUTH_LOGGING: every request logs ground_truth (fresh/stale/noise), family, request_number, trajectory_id, url, response body, ETag, Cache-Control, threshold decision, confidence (0.95/0.85), _matches outcome to raw_evidence/*.json with SHA256. Includes per-trajectory cache contents (postconditions from requests 1-5 per trajectory).

V14_PER_TRAJECTORY_OBSERVED_CACHING_AND_RESPONSE_DERIVED_ENDPOINT: cache postconditions = dom_tokens/header_tokens/action_template OBSERVED from pre-drift requests 1-5 per trajectory (not single global precomputed fresh template). Endpoint mutation detection uses response-derived signal: server emits mutated template/header in response body/headers; client compares live response signal to cached response signal (both response-derived). Closes VF-6 client-internal self-comparison and FIX-6b global-template gaps. Also exercises conditional 304 path deterministically (If-None-Match) and marks 304 as not stale.

V15_ORTHOGONAL_LEVELS_AUDIT: audit checks that adding orthogonal levels of description is not claimed as success if only Jaccard threshold tweaked; ablations must show combined signal necessary (B-JACCARD-ONLY and B-HEADER-ONLY fail), and trajectory-grouped max rho and honest sum-counter must be logged independently of detection metrics.
decision_rule: SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST if ALL of: (D1) TN_SPIDER >=0.85 AND Wilson lower >0.75; (D2) false_accept_SPIDER <=0.10; (D3) UNKNOWN in [0.00,0.50] AND within [stale_rate-0.05, stale_rate+0.07] (stale_rate 90/210=0.4286 => [0.3786,0.4986]); (D4) global ECE <=0.15 AND per-class ECE_fresh <=0.15 AND per-class ECE_stale <=0.15 under recalibrated confidences (0.95 fresh, 0.85 stale); (D5) false_accept_NO_GUARD - false_accept_SPIDER >=0.15 AND false_accept_NO_GUARD >0.10; (D6) per-family TN >=0.75 and per-family TP >=0.85 for each of 3 families; (D7) PC-STALE-DETECTION TP>=0.85 per family; (D8) NC-FRESH-RETAIN TN>=0.85 and NC-NOISE-IMMUNITY FA<=0.10; (D9) honesty gates V2-V6 pass (integer constant sum-counter without parity, max|rho_shuffled|<0.20 trajectory-grouped, within-family freshness/std>0, 5000 bootstrap done, per-trajectory caching and response-derived endpoint verified). FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if any D1-D8 fails while D9 passes (valid scientific negative on calibration or detection). MEASUREMENT_INVALID if any V2-V6 honesty gate fails, verification not deterministic _matches, 304 mishandling, server failure, or N<60 fresh+60 stale. INCONCLUSIVE if CIs straddle thresholds with width>0.20 due to underpower (N< planned) — not expected at N=210/150.
product_consequence_positive: C-FRESHNESS single-resource staleness detection survives at bounded synthetic ceiling with honest constant sum-counter, recalibrated calibration, trajectory-grouped max rho<0.20, and noise-immunity on same stdlib http.server flat-JSON site: TN>=0.85 FA<=0.10 UNKNOWN prevalence-aware calibrated, per-class/global ECE<=0.15, discriminating vs B-NO-GUARD (+0.15 FA delta) and vs single-signal ablations. This unblocks downstream C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY (rho_novelty>=0.60 with honest sum-counter M_total_f10 Pareto) and C-DELTA-REPAIR contamination-bound experiments on same synthetic substrate without distributed WAL; does NOT yet promote C-FRESHNESS to VALIDATED/PRODUCT_CORE (needs n>=800 and real-API/distributed shared-WAL 304/ETag/session validation per registry gate) and does NOT authorize WebArena-Verified v2 param-inherit re-attempt until runtime honest-WAL substrate health-gated.
product_consequence_negative: C-FRESHNESS single-resource detection falsified at tested sensitivity even after satisfiable operating-point fix: either TN<0.85, FA>0.10, UNKNOWN outside prevalence-aware bound, ECE>0.15 per-class/global, or no delta vs no-guard, or NC-NOISE-IMMUNITY FA>0.10 (noise conflated with staleness). Product must NOT use freshness gating for reuse at this 0.85 threshold and (0.95/0.85) confidence scheme on this signal set; reuse remains unsafe without selective-UNKNOWN policy or alternative threshold/signal; provides calibrated abstention baseline but keeps WebArena param-inherit pilots PARKED and keeps distributed WAL/C-PRODUCT-ECON blocked pending runtime hardening. Bounded to this signal/threshold/site, does NOT close broader C-FRESHNESS domain (other thresholds, session/token DOM drift, production CDN/304, SQLite WAL).
estimated_cost: Low: same single-node stdlib http.server synthetic site as parent, ~250 lines server + ~400 lines harness, no LLM, no browser, no Docker, no distributed infra; N=210 staleness +150 noise =360 requests, 5000 bootstraps CPU-only <10 min, <0.5 compute-hour, <$1, per-trajectory caching adds negligible memory (<500KB logs).
expected_information_gain: Very high per Director REOPEN rationale: directly tests the single highest-leverage blocked prerequisite (C-FRESHNESS 1/15 recent, blocks C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY, C-DELTA-REPAIR, C-PRODUCT-ECON per_hit). Fixes the two spec impossibilities (UNKNOWN/ECE) and two implementation deviations (parity jitter, mean rho, missing noise stimulus, global template, client-internal endpoint) that made parent MEASUREMENT_INVALID (zero information about calibration) and restores discriminating test of detection vs calibration vs noise-immunity with honest economics. Either SURVIVES (unblocks synthetic delta-repair) or FALSIFIES (calibrated negative: freshness at 0.85 threshold insufficient, requires orthogonal workflow-IR/endpoint-catalog levels) changes next product decision; MEASUREMENT_INVALID would reveal remaining substrate failure blocking 70% of recent audits. Cannot be obtained by repeating WebArena add_to_cart pilots (expected repeat MEASUREMENT_INVALID due to durability gates, marginal information ~0).
